I have been bringing both my cat, Loulou, and my dog, DJ, to Medivet Wimbledon for almost 13 years, and throughout that time I have always received outstanding care and service.

The reception team are always welcoming, kind and incredibly helpful. No matter how busy they are, they do their best to find an appointment when you need one, even at short notice, and that level of care and understanding means so much when you're worried about your pet.

A special thank you to Dr Josie, who is not only an exceptionally knowledgeable and skilled vet, but also a genuinely compassionate person. She always takes the time to explain things clearly, answer my questions and reassure me when I'm feeling overwhelmed. As a devoted pet owner who tends to get very emotional at vet appointments, her calm and caring approach has been invaluable.

I would also like to recognise Nurse Florence, who is simply wonderful. She works incredibly hard, is always warm, friendly and professional, and has a natural way with animals. DJ absolutely adores her.

Most recently, during a very stressful and worrying situation with DJ, the team went above and beyond to help us obtain an urgent referral and guide us through the next steps. Their professionalism, efficiency and genuine care gave me confidence and support at a time when I really needed it.

I cannot thank the whole team enough for everything they have done for my pets over the years. I would not hesitate to recommend Medivet Wimbledon to anyone looking for a veterinary practice that combines clinical excellence with kindness, compassion and outstanding customer care. Thank you, ladies!

The entire team were incredibly welcoming and very interested in the welfare of my cat.

We had been with Medivet for four years, but this experience was beyond unprofessional. We went to get a Health Certificate for our dog and filled out the required forms in advance as instructed. Despite this, when we arrived, something was wrong—but they completely failed to notice. It was only thanks to the travel company that we found out the paperwork was incorrect.

We immediately called Medivet and rushed back, expecting them to fix their mistake. Instead, they offered no solution, no apology, and casually said the certificate might be ready that day or the next. I was due to travel and needed the certificate signed before the day it was done. In the end, we had to think of a solution—changing ownership to my husband so he could sign it. When he went in, he was treated disrespectfully, as if the mistake was our fault and we should have known their procedures. For a service that cost £250, this was a disgrace. Medivet's incompetence nearly made us miss our flight—and they never once apologized.
